note: TD8's effect list (effects.md, The effect list): the converter's selection, by manifest path. skip: children left out (distortion needs a material we can't read, or a costly module); drop: cosmetic modules dropped; glow: the large soft glow quads (one additive soft-point billboard of 1.5 m or more), which TD11's drop-glow cut leaves to bloom; scaleRef: the event Scale at which the effect has its stock size; catalog: the choreography Catalog's names mapped to effects (variants by seed, 'elite' for elite and boss targets, 'large' at or above largeScale, 'with': spawned together); client.ambient: the ambient particles spread over the view every 2 s; the hero-centred effects skip their smoke and fire (the trails' and slam's smoke and fire, and the ring keeps only its ground wave: its fire core, rays and glow made a sunburst over the hero on every downbeat) so the hero stays in sight (ambientPerPeriod emitters, cycling through the list; TD15 swapped the warm embers for cool fireflies, environment.md Color separation); the look (ps-e8r.7; effects.md, The look): heat (the draw shader's colour ramp by luminance, edge through mid to a white-hot core), hdr and life (colour and lifetime scales), tune (per child: size, hdr, life, heat; heat false for smoke), sparks (our own built spark burst, or a list of layers) and light cues in each effect's heat colour; an entry without a prefab is built from its sparks alone (crystal-burst); client.crystalShatter: the crystal shatter's burst on each crystal death's release beat, in place of its death-burst, tinted per spawn by the type's gem (epic ps-2iq).
